data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 69.6 million in 2016, representing a 4.35% reduction of opening gross reserves. This favorable development was primarily due to general favorable claims development across the portfolio. However, the syndicate also noted an adverse impact from the Ogden discount rate change, which resulted in a GBP 53.9 million increase in Gross IBNR for UK motor and liability insurance, although this appears to be a current year adjustment or was offset by other favorable prior year movements.
